blocks.text: OrbitAvanya Tech LLP is pleased to present this formal subcontracting teaming proposal to TechForward Solutions LLC in response to Solicitation N00164-26-R-0001 issued by Federal Agency.

We propose to serve as a key subcontractor, contributing 15.0% of the total contract scope, with a specific focus on AI & Analytics. Our AI Analytics Dashboard platform directly addresses the core technical and operational requirements outlined in the solicitation.

OrbitAvanya Tech LLP brings extensive experience in enterprise software delivery, cloud-native architectures, and government-facing digital transformation initiatives. We are positioned to add measurable value to TechForward Solutions LLC's delivery capability for this engagement.
Key Highlights

items: Proposed work share: 15.0% of total contract value
Core offering: AI Analytics Dashboard for AI & Analytics
Demonstrated track record in enterprise digital transformation
Cloud-native, security-compliant architecture
Experienced delivery team with government sector expertise
Committed to on-time, on-budget delivery with SLA guarantees
